raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On SM120 (RTX PRO 6000, RTX 50 series; SM121 from the code), `trtllm_mla` fails today:

1. Decode fails on SM12x because the backend passes a counter buffer that FlashInfer's XQA kernel rejects. Since v0.5.17 (#31927), `TRTLLMMLABackend` always passes `multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer` for its default `trtllm-gen` backend without naming a `backend`, so FlashInfer's `auto` picks XQA off SM10x ([`mla/_core.py:4205-4210`](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/blob/v0.7.2/flashinfer/mla/_core.py#L4205-L4210)), and XQA rejects the counter ([`_core.py:4291-4294`](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/blob/v0.7.2/flashinfer/mla/_core.py#L4291-L4294)). With CUDA graphs the server never becomes ready; without them the first decode fails.
2. Prefill: the TRTLLM MLA prefill kernel is SM10x only. With prefill CUDA graphs off (the default for DeepSeek-V3/R1 with `trtllm_mla` prefill), the first prefill fails with `Unsupported architecture` (#24633). With the default breakable prefill graph on other MLA models, the backend falls back to FlashInfer's MLA prefill inside the graph, and requests succeed (on main, 8- and 6,000-token prompts with `--prefill-attention-backend trtllm_mla --decode-attention-backend triton`).

Fixes #24633 for server launches, with the clearer startup error proposed there. Default MLA launches on SM12x use `triton` and don't change. One behavior change to weigh: the new prefill check also refuses those prefill-graph launches that work on main (question 1).

## Modifications

1. `TRTLLMMLABackend` skips the counter when `is_sm120_supported()` (SM120 and SM121). SM10x keeps it; nothing else in the decode call changes. SM11x is left as is: `auto` picks XQA there too, but XQA's MLA kernel exists only for SM120 and SM121 ([`xqa.py:633-634`](https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/blob/v0.7.2/flashinfer/xqa.py#L633-L634)), so decode fails on SM11x with or without the counter.
2. `_mla_kv_cache_dtype_checks` keeps main's Blackwell and KV dtype checks (now also accepting the documented `bfloat16` alias) and adds one: `trtllm_mla` as the resolved prefill backend off SM10x fails at startup with "TRTLLM MLA prefill requires SM10x (datacenter Blackwell). Please use a different prefill backend, such as --prefill-attention-backend flashinfer." On SM11x and SM12x this refuses `--attention-backend trtllm_mla` without a prefill override and `--prefill-attention-backend trtllm_mla`.
3. New test `test/registered/attention/test_trtllm_mla_sm120_decode.py` (`1-gpu-small`, the RTX 5090 runner, in `base-b`). It starts servers with FlashInfer prefill, `trtllm_mla` decode and CUDA graphs, with BF16 and `fp8_e4m3` KV, and checks that `--attention-backend trtllm_mla` is refused. The model is `DEFAULT_MLA_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST` with dummy weights, cut to 2 layers and 128 heads through `--json-model-override-args`.
4. Docs (`attention_backend.mdx`): on SM12x, TRTLLM MLA is decode only, with exactly 128 query heads per rank (XQA's requirement, so DeepSeek-V3/R1 needs `--attn-dp-size` equal to `--tp`), BF16 or `fp8_e4m3` KV, and the default `--speculative-attention-mode prefill`.

#35807 (open) edits the same code and keeps the counter for dense decode; a merge that keeps its decode block brings the SM12x failure back. I'm happy to rebase onto it if it lands first.

Questions (if nobody has a preference, the PR stays as is):

1. Should the prefill check allow `trtllm_mla` prefill while the prefill CUDA graph is on, since it then runs FlashInfer's kernel anyway? I refused it so the error names the kernel that actually runs.
2. Would a startup check for the 128-head limit help? Today it fails at graph capture.

## Accuracy Tests

One RTX PRO 6000 (SM120), main's pins (torch 2.14.1, FlashInfer 0.7.2). The head `cb802d42a6` is this PR rebased onto main `03a27e2a17`; the conflict was in `test_server_args.py` only.

- On the GPU: `test_trtllm_mla_sm120_decode.py` passes both tests (both servers, BF16 and `fp8_e4m3` KV, with CUDA graphs, 253 s), and `test_sm12x_decode_omits_trtllm_gen_counter` passes, with nothing skipped.
- On CPU: `test_server_args.py`, 357 passed.
- With main's code (before the rebase), both decode servers exit at graph capture, the refusal case gets no error, and the 4 new-behavior `TestTrtllmMlaArchGuard` tests fail.
- Servers (DeepSeek-V2-Lite config, dummy weights, 2 layers, 128 heads), measured on an earlier head with the same backend change:

| setup | main | this PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--attention-backend trtllm_mla`, graphs off | first prefill fails | refused at startup |
| FlashInfer prefill, `trtllm_mla` decode, BF16 or FP8 KV, graphs off | first decode fails | serves every request |
| the same with CUDA graphs | never ready | serves every request |

Dummy weights only show that decode completes, so I replayed the recorded decode call against an fp32 reference: relative L2 error 2.2e-3 with BF16 KV and 2.3e-2 with FP8 KV (XQA rounds the softmax weights to e4m3), and references with a deliberate mistake score at least 3 times worse.

In CI, the registered test jobs, including the new `base-b` test, need a maintainer to add the `run-ci` label. Not run: SM100, SM11x and SM121 GPUs, attention DP, speculative decoding, PD. Details: https://gist.github.com/waynehacking8/a858496a37383dd4a6a93258f8a0d5d8

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A: startup checks and one decode argument.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A: argument validation and one decode argument; the decode output check is above.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

### Preview approval required

This pull request comes from a fork, so Mintlify won't build a preview until someone with write access approves commit `cb802d4`.

[Approve preview](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28837/checks?check_run_id=126624814511)

This fixes `trtllm_mla` decode on SM12x, where XQA rejects the counter buffer, and turns the SM10x-only prefill into a startup error. Its three new CUDA tests pass on an RTX PRO 6000. One decision is open in the description (question 1): the new prefill check also refuses `trtllm_mla` prefill launches that work on main through the prefill CUDA graph.

@Fridge003, could you take a look when you have time? It conflicts with main again only in `test_server_args.py`, and I'll rebase as soon as you want CI run.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the compatibility checks for the `trtllm_mla` attention backend in `server_args.py` by separating prefill and decode validation. It restricts the prefill backend to SM100/SM103 (datacenter Blackwell) architectures to prevent crashes on workstation/consumer Blackwell GPUs (SM120/SM121), while continuing to allow the decode backend on all Blackwell architectures. Corresponding unit tests have been added to verify this behavior. There are no review comments, and I have no feedback to provide.

+"""TRTLLM MLA decode on SM120/SM121, where FlashInfer runs it on the XQA kernel.
+
+Decode must not pass the trtllm-gen multi-CTA KV counter, which XQA rejects
+during CUDA graph capture; TRTLLM MLA prefill must be refused at startup.
+"""
+
+import json
+import unittest
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.srt.server_args import prepare_server_args
+from sglang.srt.utils import is_sm120_supported
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_MLA_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST,
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+    terminate_and_kill_process_tree,
+)
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=130, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+# XQA MLA only supports 128 query heads per rank; two layers keep startup short.
+MODEL_OVERRIDE_ARGS = json.dumps({"num_hidden_layers": 2, "num_attention_heads": 128})
+MAX_NEW_TOKENS = 8
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(is_sm120_supported(), "requires an SM120/SM121 GPU")
+class TestTrtllmMlaSm120Decode(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_decode_with_cuda_graph(self):
+        for kv_cache_dtype in ("bf16", "fp8_e4m3"):
+            with self.subTest(kv_cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype):
+                process = popen_launch_server(
+                    DEFAULT_MLA_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST,
+                    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+                    timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+                    other_args=[
+                        "--load-format",
+                        "dummy",
+                        "--json-model-override-args",
+                        MODEL_OVERRIDE_ARGS,
+                        "--prefill-attention-backend",
+                        "flashinfer",
+                        "--decode-attention-backend",
+                        "trtllm_mla",
+                        "--kv-cache-dtype",
+                        kv_cache_dtype,
+                        "--cuda-graph-backend-decode",
+                        "full",
+                        "--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode",
+                        "4",
+                        "--max-total-tokens",
+                        "4096",
+                    ],
+                )
+                try:
+                    response = requests.post(
+                        DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST + "/generate",
+                        json={
+                            "text": ["The capital of France is", "1 2 3 4 5 6 7"],
+                            "sampling_params": {
+                                "max_new_tokens": MAX_NEW_TOKENS,
+                                "temperature": 0,
+                                "ignore_eos": True,
+                            },
+                        },
+                        timeout=120,
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+                    outputs = response.json()
+                    self.assertEqual(len(outputs), 2)
+                    for output in outputs:
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            output["meta_info"]["completion_tokens"], MAX_NEW_TOKENS
+                        )
+                finally:
+                    terminate_and_kill_process_tree(process)
+
+    def test_trtllm_mla_prefill_rejected(self):
+        server_args = prepare_server_args(
+            [
+                "--model-path",
+                DEFAULT_MLA_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST,
+                "--json-model-override-args",
+                MODEL_OVERRIDE_ARGS,
+                "--attention-backend",
+                "trtllm_mla",
+            ]
+        )
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "TRTLLM MLA prefill requires SM10x"):
+            server_args.resolve_once()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

@@ -240,6 +240,26 @@ def _call(
                 return_lse=return_lse,
             )
 
+    def test_sm12x_decode_omits_trtllm_gen_counter(self):
+        for sm12x in (False, True):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(sm12x=sm12x),
+                patch.object(backend_module, "is_sm120_supported", return_value=sm12x),
+            ):
+                backend = self._make_backend()
+                counter = backend._multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer = object()
+                calls = []
+                self._call(
+                    backend,
+                    q_len=1,
+                    dcp_enabled=False,
+                    kernel=lambda **kw: calls.append(kw),
+                )
+                if sm12x:
+                    self.assertNotIn("multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer", calls[0])
+                else:
+                    self.assertIs(calls[0]["multi_ctas_kv_counter_buffer"], counter)
+
     def test_multi_token_query_under_dcp_raises(self):
         with self.assertRaises(NotImplementedError):
             self._call(self._make_backend(), q_len=NUM_DRAFT_TOKENS, dcp_enabled=True)

@@ -5458,5 +5458,150 @@ def test_rust_response_without_provenance_rejected(self) -> None:
                 handle_cache_compatibility(args)
 
 
+class TestTrtllmMlaArchGuard(CustomTestCase):
+    def _make_args(self, **overrides):
+        args = ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", device="cuda")
+        args._model_config = MagicMock()
+        args._model_config.is_encoder_decoder = False
+        args._model_config.context_len = 1
+        args._model_config.hf_config.architectures = []
+        args._model_config.hf_config.dual_chunk_attention_config = None
+        for key, value in overrides.items():
+            setattr(args, key, value)
+        return args
+
+    @override_platform(is_sm100=False, is_sm120=True, is_blackwell=True)
+    def test_combined_trtllm_mla_prefill_rejected_on_sm120(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "SM10x"):
+            handle_attention_backend_compatibility(
+                self._make_args(attention_backend="trtllm_mla")
+            )
+
+    @override_platform(is_sm100=False, is_sm120=True, is_blackwell=True)
+    def test_explicit_trtllm_mla_prefill_rejected_on_sm120(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "SM10x"):
+            handle_attention_backend_compatibility(
+                self._make_args(
+                    attention_backend="triton",
+                    prefill_attention_backend="trtllm_mla",
+                )
+            )
+
+    @override_platform(is_sm100=False, is_sm120=True, is_blackwell=True)
+    def test_safe_prefill_with_trtllm_mla_decode_allowed_on_sm120(self):
+        args = self._make_args(
+            attention_backend="triton",
+            prefill_attention_backend="flashinfer",
+            decode_attention_backend="trtllm_mla",
+        )
+
+        handle_attention_backend_compatibility(args)
+
+        self.assertEqual(resolution_result(args, "attention_backend"), "triton")
+        self.assertEqual(
+            resolution_result(args, "prefill_attention_backend"), "flashinfer"
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            resolution_result(args, "decode_attention_backend"), "trtllm_mla"
+        )
+
+    def test_trtllm_mla_prefill_allowed_on_sm100_family(self):
+        for sm in (100, 103, 107):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(sm=sm),
+                override_platform(
+                    is_cuda=True,
+                    is_sm100=True,
+                    is_sm120=False,
+                    is_blackwell=True,
+                    device_sm=sm,
+                ),
+            ):
+                args = self._make_args(
+                    attention_backend="triton",
+                    prefill_attention_backend="trtllm_mla",
+                )
+                handle_attention_backend_compatibility(args)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    resolution_result(args, "prefill_attention_backend"),
+                    "trtllm_mla",
+                )
+
+    @override_platform(is_sm100=False, is_sm120=False, is_blackwell=False)
+    def test_trtllm_mla_decode_rejected_off_blackwell(self):
+        for backends in (
+            {"attention_backend": "triton", "decode_attention_backend": "trtllm_mla"},
+            {"attention_backend": "trtllm_mla"},
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(**backends):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
+                    handle_attention_backend_compatibility(self._make_args(**backends))
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    str(context.exception),
+                    "TRTLLM MLA backend is only supported on Blackwell GPUs (SM100/SM12x). Please use a different backend.",
+                )
+
+    @override_platform(is_sm100=True, is_sm120=False, is_blackwell=True)
+    def test_trtllm_mla_invalid_kv_cache_dtype_rejected(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as context:
+            handle_attention_backend_compatibility(
+                self._make_args(
+                    attention_backend="triton",
+                    decode_attention_backend="trtllm_mla",
+                    kv_cache_dtype="float16",
+                )
+            )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            str(context.exception),
+            "TensorRT-LLM MLA backend only supports kv-cache-dtype of fp8_e4m3, bf16, or auto.",
+        )
+
+    @override_platform(is_sm100=True, is_sm120=False, is_blackwell=True)
+    def test_trtllm_mla_accepts_bfloat16_kv_cache_dtype(self):
+        for backends in (
+            {"attention_backend": "trtllm_mla"},
+            {"attention_backend": "triton", "decode_attention_backend": "trtllm_mla"},
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(**backends):
+                handle_attention_backend_compatibility(
+                    self._make_args(kv_cache_dtype="bfloat16", **backends)
+                )
+
+    @override_platform(is_sm100=True, is_sm120=False, is_blackwell=True)
+    def test_trtllm_mla_prefill_only_keeps_kv_cache_dtype_unchecked(self):
+        args = self._make_args(
+            attention_backend="triton",
+            prefill_attention_backend="trtllm_mla",
+            decode_attention_backend="triton",
+            kv_cache_dtype="fp8_e5m2",
+        )
+
+        handle_attention_backend_compatibility(args)
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            resolution_result(args, "prefill_attention_backend"), "trtllm_mla"
+        )
+
+    @override_platform(is_sm100=False, is_sm120=False, is_blackwell=False)
+    def test_trtllm_mla_prefill_rejected_off_blackwell(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "TRTLLM MLA prefill requires SM10x"):
+            handle_attention_backend_compatibility(
+                self._make_args(
+                    attention_backend="triton",
+                    prefill_attention_backend="trtllm_mla",
+                )
+            )
+
+    @override_platform(is_sm100=False, is_sm120=True, is_blackwell=True)
+    def test_global_trtllm_mla_overridden_in_both_phases_allowed_on_sm120(self):
+        handle_attention_backend_compatibility(
+            self._make_args(
+                attention_backend="trtllm_mla",
+                prefill_attention_backend="flashinfer",
+                decode_attention_backend="triton",
+            )
+        )
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()

### Preview approval required

This pull request comes from a fork, so Mintlify won't build a preview until someone with write access approves commit `cb802d4`.

[Approve preview](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28837/checks?check_run_id=126624814511)

This fixes `trtllm_mla` decode on SM12x, where XQA rejects the counter buffer, and turns the SM10x-only prefill into a startup error. Its three new CUDA tests pass on an RTX PRO 6000. One decision is open in the description (question 1): the new prefill check also refuses `trtllm_mla` prefill launches that work on main through the prefill CUDA graph.

@Fridge003, could you take a look when you have time? It conflicts with main again only in `test_server_args.py`, and I'll rebase as soon as you want CI run.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the compatibility checks for the `trtllm_mla` attention backend in `server_args.py` by separating prefill and decode validation. It restricts the prefill backend to SM100/SM103 (datacenter Blackwell) architectures to prevent crashes on workstation/consumer Blackwell GPUs (SM120/SM121), while continuing to allow the decode backend on all Blackwell architectures. Corresponding unit tests have been added to verify this behavior. There are no review comments, and I have no feedback to provide.
